messages:
maya: Heads-up: during vuln triage this morning we noticed a potential audit access gap. Scoped service-accounts created for analytics can list audit streams across tenants if they were granted `audit.read` at org-level. Is that expected? we need to confirm admin vs member visibility for exported events. cc @sam @alex

sam: We should not be exposing cross-tenant audit reads. That's a bug. Which permission grants were applied?

maya: It was the service-account role `platform-analytics` created by infra; role includes `audit.read` (org). I can paste the role binding:```
role: platform-analytics
bindings:
  - subject: serviceAccount:analytics-pipeline
    perms:
      - audit.read
      - metrics.read
  scope: org
```

alex: TL;DR: we intended `audit.read` to be tenant-scoped by default. Org-level was an escape hatch we didn't expect to be used on service accounts. Two things we should do: (1) block org-scoped audit read for service accounts by default (RBAC enforcement) and (2) add explicit fields to the audit schema so exported events include principal.scope + principal.auditable_tenant list for customer-facing exports.

jin: Also, KMS signing needs to include tenant metadata in the signed payload. If the signature has no tenant claim, customers can't verify which tenant the signed export belongs to.

sam: Agreed. Proposal for schema change: add `principal:{id,type,scope}` and `export.signature:{key_id,kms_sig,signed_metadata}`. For UI/backends, member view should redact `tenant_id` except for admins and tokens explicitly scoped to the tenant.

maya: Can we also add a small validation endpoint `/audit/validate` that takes an export blob + signature and returns verification status + signed_metadata? That would help customers and our e2e.

incident-bot: Incident-bot: created issue #314 "audit-access-gap" assigned to sam (priority: P1)

sam: I'll own the RBAC fix and the rollout plan. Steps: 1) short patch to RBAC enforcement to deny org-level `audit.read` for serviceAccounts by default (sam) 2) schema PR to add principal.scope and export.signature (sam+maya) 3) migration/validator that verifies KMS-signed exports include tenant metadata (jin) 4) e2e with mock KMS and a customer validation flow (jin). ETA: EOD Wed for initial patch, full rollout next week.

maya: I'll draft a customer-facing note explaining the new event fields and how to validate exports, plus admin vs member visibility guides. Will post to /announcements once ready.

alex: Add regression tests preventing service accounts with org perms from reading tenant exports unless explicitly allowed. Also update our canary to exercise scoped tokens.

jin: I'll add CI checks to the audit validation harness and include a mock KMS key rotation test.

sam: Quick question: for historical exports that were signed without tenant metadata, do we re-sign them, or mark them unverifiable?

alex: Short-term: mark old exports as "unverifiable" in the UI and provide a re-export flow that re-signs with tenant metadata. Long-term: re-sign during migration where feasible.

maya: Action items recap: sam - RBAC patch by Tue; sam+maya - schema PR by Wed; jin - validator + CI by Fri; maya - public note by Thu. I'll create a tracking ticket and link here.

sec-bot: Reminder: created tracking ticket SEC-873, label: urgent, assigned to sec-triage.

sam: Thanks all. I'll post the RBAC patch link here when ready.
